mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5% MoM does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase > 1% MoM does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above 3% YoY, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs MoM signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 MoM does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r > 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.3% MoM, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE increases > 0.3% MoM
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of declining HOUST and rising UNRATE does not correlate with negative returns (Pearson's r < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a strong economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances despite the positive signal, or GDPC1 increase does not correlate with positive returns (Pearson's r > 0.1).
